newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures close mixed, ignore weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures close mixed, ignore weak yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Thursday, drawing little support from the weaker yen as bearish sentiment continued to grip the market, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen lower to 0.3 yen higher, with the benchmark June contract down 0.4 yen at 145.5 yen per kg. The day's volume was 10,899 lots.

Local investors were sidelined amid disappointment that the weaker yen failed to support the market, traders said. "This proved how bearish market sentiment is," a brokerage house analyst said. Open interest in the spot January contract, which expires next Monday, stood at 5,124 lots as of January 22.
